body:
Let f(x) = sin(2x). What is the average rate of change of f on the interval [0, π/4]?

A. 2√2/π
B. 4/π
C. 1
D. -4/π

Let g(x) = 3cos(2x) + 1. What is the average rate of change of g on the interval [π/6, 5π/6]?

A. 0
B. 3√3
C. -3√3
D. -9√3/(2π)

The height of a weight bouncing on a spring is modeled by h(t) = 12 + 5sin(2t) centimeters, where t is the time in seconds. What is the average rate of change of h over the time interval π/6 ≤ t ≤ π/2?

A. 15√3/(2π) cm per second
B. -5√3/2 cm per second
C. -15√3/(2π) cm per second
D. -5 cm per second

The table gives selected values of a function f.

x: 0, 2, 3, 5, 7, 9
f(x): 1, 10, 16, 28, 24, 26

On which of the following intervals is the average rate of change of f greatest?

A. [2, 3]
B. [5, 7]
C. [7, 9]
D. [0, 2]

Let f(x) = x³ - 6x. On which of the following intervals is the average rate of change of f greatest?

A. [0, 5]
B. [2, 5]
C. [1, 5]
D. [3, 4]

The volume of water in a reservoir is modeled by V(t) = 40√(t + 1) - 4t thousand cubic meters, where t is the time in days, 0 ≤ t ≤ 35. On which of the following intervals is the average rate of change of V least?

A. [0, 15]
B. [3, 8]
C. [8, 15]
D. [3, 35]
